answer: The voyage report exposes the merge explicitly at each ivory. Each collapsed cluster gets one wharf weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, an copycat who spins up 100 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 97 times the capital for one share. A farm of 4122 identities would post 1892 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
